verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents its own workflows feature for automating processes, and its prospecting agent watches account signals and reaches out automatically, which points to event-driven automation. However, the evidence is a one-line mention and never describes how rules are defined, which triggers or events are available, or which actions can be taken. missing for 10: documentation of trigger types and enrollment rules, catalog of workflow actions, branching/conditional logic depth, API or AI-native rule definition, independent or hands-on corroboration.
